Hits are selected locally from prior run-scoped generic searches and verified full-text anchors.

hits.title: A Framework for Evaluating Agentic Skills at Scale
hits.reason: Measures with-skill versus without-skill marginal utility across realistic tasks but does not predict cost-adjusted benefit from a cheaper paired micro-reproduction on independently supplied user tasks.

hits.title: PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research
hits.reason: Includes a cheaper Code-Dev proxy and full execution-based replication, but evaluates replication fidelity rather than user-task intervention utility.

hits.title: AutoReproduce: Automatic AI Experiment Reproduction with Paper Lineage
hits.reason: Uses sampled mini-batches and dry runs for rapid executability checks, not a calibrated intervention-versus-control net-benefit prediction.

hits.title: Cost-Sensitive Multi-Fidelity Bayesian Optimization with Transfer of Learning Curve Extrapolation
hits.reason: Combines user-defined cost-performance utility, prediction from cheap observations, and automatic stopping, but assumes a shared optimization and learning-curve setting rather than paper-derived heterogeneous interventions.

hits.title: A Unified Framework for the Transportability of Population-Level Causal Measures
hits.reason: Transports treatment effects to a target population under covariate-shift assumptions; it is a direct threat to the target-task benefit claim but does not construct paper-derived executable probes.
